explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/225 (Saff–Sheil-Small; Kristiansen): a trigonometric polynomial Σ_{k≤n} c_k e^{ikθ} with all complex zeros real and max |f| = 1 on [0,2π] has ∫|f| ≤ 4. The normalisation c₀c_n ≠ 0, n ≥ 1 is necessary and well justified. A single exponential has no zeros (vacuously all real) and integral 2π > 4, and multiplying by e^{imθ} changes neither the zeros nor |f|. Formal proof linked.
